title: F5 security advisory (AV26-949)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-949 Date: September 22, 2026 As of September 22, 2026, F5 is affected by a vulnerability in the following product: BIG-IP Versions 21.1.0 to Hotfix-BIGIP-21.1.0.2.0.30.22-ENG Versions 17.5.0 to Hotfix-BIGIP-17.5.1.9.0.160.12-ENG Versions 17.1.0 to Hotfix-BIGIP-17.1.3.5.0.41.14-ENG F5 has reported that CVE-2026-94127 is being exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
